name: Union County, NJ
findings: Union County has 1,938 nonprofit organizations. 790 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 655 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Union County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few research and think tank organizations list membership
observations.text: 9 research and think tank organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 23 would.

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through research and think tank groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Foundation organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 19 foundation organizations here list public events, compared with about 9 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do foundation organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 199 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 199 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
